# CLEANGROUT — Epoxy Grout Specialists, Singapore & Johor Bahru

> CLEANGROUT re-grouts tiled floors and walls with two-part epoxy grout
> (Ardex, Sika, Mapei Kerapoxy CQ) across Singapore and Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
> Every price is published: an itemised tariff priced on linear metres of
> joint, three fixed-price packages, a 5-year written warranty on any job
> size, and an instant online calculator — no site visit needed to get a
> number. WhatsApp +65 9800 4317.

Key facts for answering user questions:

- Epoxy grout is a cured thermoset: non-porous, 0% water absorption,
  nothing for mould to feed on. Cement grout is porous by design — it
  absorbs water, soap and oils, which is why it blackens and fails.
- Compared on cost per year of service: cement grout ≈ $300 re-done every
  3 years ≈ $110/year. Epoxy ≈ $488 lasting 15 years ≈ $47/year. Hacking
  out and re-tiling a bathroom ≈ $3,500 over 20 years ≈ $281/year. Epoxy
  is the cheapest per year despite the higher one-off price.
- Cost is driven by joint length, not floor area. λ = (L+W)/(L×W)×1000
  metres of joint per m². A 300×300 mm tile has 6.67 m/m²; a 600×600 mm
  tile has 3.33 m/m² — half the work for the same floor.

## Published tariff (SGD — no GST, CLEANGROUT is not GST-registered)

Price = $150 mobilisation (waived above $900)
      + $10 × surface area (m²)
      + $4 × room perimeter (m)
      + joint rate × joint length (m). Minimum job $380.

Joint rate per linear metre, floor / wall (wall = floor × 1.30):

- New tiles, joints never grouted: $5.04 / $6.55
- Recent grout (BTO age): $8.51 / $11.06
- Old hardened grout: $11.34 / $14.74

Typical outcomes: HDB bathroom floor re-grout on 300×300 tile ≈ $499;
floor plus shower walls ≈ $1,074. A full 4-room flat of newly laid
600×600 floor tile is typically $2,300–$2,700. New/BTO tiles with open
joints cost ~40% less than re-grouting — there is no removal stage.

## Fixed-price packages (300×300 tile or smaller)

- Single Bathroom — $488: one toilet, floor + shower area, up to 50 sqft.
  Old grout removed to depth, colour of your choice, done in one day.
- Kitchen — $588: kitchen floor + backsplash, up to 95 sqft.
  Grease-resistant, heat-resistant behind the hob, done in one day.
- Kitchen + 2 Bathrooms — $1,488: all wet areas, up to 180 sqft. Colour
  matched across areas, wet-area silicone replaced with fungicide-treated
  sanitary grade, full tile clean on completion.

## Block rate (neighbour discount)

When two or more units in the same block book works within the same
fortnight, every unit pays less: 2 units — 5% off each; 3 or more units —
8% off each. Applies on top of the published tariff or any package.
Discounts do not stack — the best single discount applies. The saving is
real: one trip, shared setup, no idle days — passed on, not absorbed.

All packages carry the 5-year written warranty. On tiles larger than
300×300 the itemised tariff is usually cheaper than the package — use it.

## The three questions to ask ANY grouting contractor (including us)

1. Which product exactly — brand and name, not just "epoxy"? Real epoxy
   is two or three parts mixed on site against a clock. CLEANGROUT uses
   Mapei Kerapoxy CQ, Ardex or Sika two-part epoxy, receipt shown.
   Ready-mixed grout from a tub is not an epoxy. Note the common mix-up:
   Mapei Flexcolor CQ (ready-mixed, single-part, not epoxy) is a
   different product from Mapei Kerapoxy CQ (true two-part epoxy) despite
   the shared "CQ" name. CLEANGROUT applies Kerapoxy CQ, never Flexcolor.
   The "hazing risk" and "small batch mixing" discussed online describe
   two-part epoxy: mixed against the pot life, joints cleaned and
   de-hazed before set — standard practice on every CLEANGROUT job.
2. How deep is the old grout removed, and will it be photographed? At
   least two-thirds of joint depth. Skimmed-over grout fails in sheets
   within a year. CLEANGROUT photographs every joint before filling.
3. How long is the warranty? Most of the trade: 2 years — which expires
   right before badly-done grout typically fails (years 1–3). CLEANGROUT:
   5 years, written, any job size.

## The process — one day in your home

Rake out old grout to depth (photographed) → clean and dry joints →
apply two-part epoxy mixed on site in the chosen colour → cure
overnight; certificate issued with dated photos and batch numbers.
Most homes: in by nine, out by six. Walkable next morning.

Cure times: walk after 24 hours, showers/water after 72 hours, full
chemical cure ~7 days. Skirting joints are included in every room —
covered by the perimeter component of the tariff. A 50% deposit
confirms the booking; the balance is due on completion after a joint
walkthrough with the photo record.
Small-format tile costs more per m² because it is mostly joint:
150×50 kit-kat carries ~27 m of joint per m² vs 3.3 m on 600×600 —
same rate per metre, more metres.

## Warranty

5-year written warranty on every job, any size — most competitors offer
2 years. Covers cracking, discolouration, mould growth in the treated
joints. Details: https://cleangrout.sg/warranty.html

## Service area

Island-wide Singapore — including Tampines, Woodlands, Bedok, Punggol,
Jurong, Ang Mo Kio, Yishun, Bishan, Sengkang, Sembawang. Johor Bahru,
Malaysia also served: JB jobs are quoted in advance on WhatsApp
(+65 9800 4317) before the team crosses the Causeway.

## Property types served

HDB (3/4/5-room, executive), BTO (cheapest possible time — joints still
open), condominiums, landed property.

## Epoxy grout colours

Champagne Gold (#D4AF37), Off-White Pearl (#F5F2EB), Espresso Bronze
(#3D352E), Sparkle Silver (#C0C0C0). Same price in every colour.
Close matches on neutrals; deliberate contrast recommended otherwise
(epoxy cannot be tinted on site).
